decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to swarm the board with small white creatures and pump them up with anthems and pump spells to overwhelm the opponent quickly. The deck aims to play aggressively and efficiently, using cards like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Champion of the Parish to grow the board presence while disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Esper Sentinel and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben. The deck also has protection and evasion with cards like Solitude and Mutavault to ensure the creatures can get through for damage.

This deck focuses on quickly casting spells with a converted mana cost of 3 or less to trigger cascade effects, allowing you to cast more powerful spells for free. With a mix of creatures, instant spells, and cascade enablers, you aim to overwhelm your opponent with a continuous stream of threats while disrupting their game plan with counterspells and bounce effects. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, you can set up explosive turns and put pressure on your opponent early in the game.

This deck focuses on quickly casting spells with cascade mechanics to overwhelm the opponent's board and hand. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck can consistently cascade into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Fury. The goal is to flood the battlefield with creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan with bounce and removal spells. The inclusion of Brazen Borrower and Prismari Command adds versatility to the deck, allowing for additional control options. The deck aims to quickly close out games with aggressive plays and tempo advantage.

This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to bring out powerful creatures such as Archon of Cruelty and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker from the library or hand. It also uses Persist to bring back creatures from the graveyard and Wrenn and Six for additional control. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with big creatures while disrupting their plans with Thoughtseize and removal spells like Fatal Push and Lightning Bolt. By carefully timing and sequencing spells, the deck can quickly assemble a winning board state through a creative combo approach.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling a powerful equipment combo to overwhelm the opponent. By using cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Puresteel Paladin, along with Colossus Hammer and Sigarda's Aid, the deck can easily equip powerful creatures with massive boosts in attacking power. By utilizing cards like Spell Pierce for protection and Urza's Saga for additional searching power, the deck aims to set up a quick and decisive victory using its powerful equipment and combo pieces.

The key concept of the deck is to use instant reanimation spells like Goryo's Vengeance and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to quickly bring powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Atraxa, Grand Unifier onto the battlefield. These creatures, along with Territorial Kavu, Djeru and Hazoret, provide aggressive damage and board control. The deck also utilizes Fury of the Horde as a way to get additional combat steps and attack multiple times in a turn. The mana base includes a variety of fetchlands and shocklands to ensure consistent mana fixing. The deck aims to win the game quickly by combining these elements of reanimation and aggression.

This deck focuses on playing aggressively with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Dragon's Rage Channeler. It also utilizes control elements with Counterspell and Lightning Bolt to disrupt opponents while maintaining pressure. Card selection and filtering are done through spells like Consider and Expressive Iteration. The deck aims to close out games quickly by deploying threats early and protecting them with counterspells. The combination of aggressive creatures, control elements, and card selection helps ensure consistency and versatility in various matchups.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on casting cheap spells to control the board and pressure the opponent early with efficient threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler. The deck also utilizes spell recursion with Murktide Regent and Unholy Heat to maintain card advantage and tempo. With a mix of threats, disruption, and card selection, this deck aims to quickly close out games by overwhelming the opponent with a fast and versatile game plan. The inclusion of Blood Moon can also disrupt the opponent's mana base and give this deck an edge in certain matchups.

The deck revolves around quickly ramping up mana using Amulet of Vigor and lands like Simic Growth Chamber and Tolaria West to cheat out powerful threats like Primeval Titan and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove. By utilizing cards like Azusa, Lost but Seeking and Explore, the deck aims to assemble the Amulet Titan combo to accelerate its game plan and overwhelm the opponent with powerful land synergies. With multiple ways to tutor for key pieces and protective lands like Cavern of Souls and Bojuka Bog, the deck seeks to create a dominating board presence and win through explosive plays.

This deck aims to efficiently ramp up mana using cards like Arboreal Grazer and Amulet of Vigor to quickly play powerful creatures like Primeval Titan and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove. By utilizing lands like Urza's Saga and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle, the deck can generate value and finish off opponents with big hits. The addition of Atraxa, Grand Unifier helps to support the combo strategy by making cards like Explore more powerful. The inclusion of cards like Dramatic Entrance and Summoner's Pact allow for flexibility and consistency in executing the combo.

This aggressive red deck focuses on dealing damage quickly and efficiently to the opponent with powerful creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear, complemented by a plethora of burn spells such as Lightning Bolt, Lava Spike, and Searing Blaze. The deck aims to keep the pressure on the opponent, while also preventing them from gaining life with cards like Skullcrack and Boros Charm. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of fast creatures and direct damage spells, ultimately securing a swift victory.

This deck focuses on using a variety of creatures with beneficial enter-the-battlefield effects to quickly assemble a powerful combination that can overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, the deck can easily search for and put into play key creatures like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide. These creatures can generate incremental value through sacrificing other creatures, dealing damage, and/or generating additional resources. The deck also includes some versatile lands that can help fix mana and protect against counterspells.

This deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat out high-cost creatures like Archon of Cruelty while controlling the game with spells like Spell Pierce and Lightning Bolt. Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six provide additional control options and card advantage. The mana base allows for consistent access to all colors needed for the combo. Leyline Binding acts as a disruption tool to handle opposing threats. The deck showcases a blend of combo potential and flexibility through its various card choices and interactions.

The main concept of this Modern Combo - Hammer Time deck is to assemble the pieces necessary to equip Colossus Hammer onto a creature such as Ornithopter or Gingerbrute, allowing for powerful and efficient attacks. The deck utilizes Stoneforge Mystic and Puresteel Paladin to search for and equip the necessary artifacts. Cards like Sigarda's Aid and Urza's Saga help to enable this strategy, while disruption is provided by cards like Spell Pierce and Esper Sentinel. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a large, unblockable creature equipped with multiple powerful artifacts.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and powerful removal spells to quickly overwhelm and disrupt the opponent. With a mix of efficient creatures like Ragavan and Seasoned Pyromancer, supported by spells like Lightning Bolt and Solitude, the deck aims to maintain control of the board while dealing consistent damage to the opponent. The inclusion of powerful finishers like Elesh Norn and Timeless Dragon provides additional threats that can quickly close out games. Additionally, cards like Blood Moon and Prismatic Ending help disrupt the opponent's game plan, giving the deck an edge in various matchups.

The main concept of this deck is to cycle through your cards quickly and efficiently to fill up your graveyard with creatures, then cast Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield at once. This combo strategy allows you to overwhelm your opponent with a sudden swarm of creatures, putting them on the back foot and potentially securing a quick victory. The deck includes a mix of creatures with cycling abilities, recursion spells, and counter magic to protect your game plan and disrupt your opponent's strategies.
